name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
description: A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.
source: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Fae of Crystalline Flesh
